shared_elements: dense field of repeated small carved motifs in ordered rows/columns
justification: Both show relief carving organized into repeating registers on a monumental stone structure with a stepped element and human figures present, but that is generic to monumental carving traditions. A depicts a tall free-standing slab covered in a two-column grid of rounded, deeply modelled glyph-like blocks with a living onlooker seated on its plinth, while B shows a stairway flanked by flat, linear low-relief panels of stylized leaf/rosette forms and processional figures in profile; the specific motifs, their forms and their relationships share nothing distinctive.
